Before you hire a single agent, there's one question to ask about every task in your week: who clicks the final button?
Sort your work into three piles.
Agent alone: research, summaries, sorting, and drafts saved as drafts.
Agent drafts, you approve: customer emails, social posts, proposals and invoices, anything with your name on it.
Only you: moving money, signing contracts, tax and legal calls.
If a mistake would leave your business or touch money, a human clicks the final button.
That holds even when a product allows more.
Claude Duet, for example, can check out with a one-time virtual card after your approval.
In this course, the house rule is stricter: agents never move money.
That's where your first hire comes from, and in the exercise you'll build that map from your own week.
